description: Neural Analog processes existing audio: restore recordings, master mixes, separate stems, transcribe music to MIDI, apply saved audio workflows, adjust Studio effects, and download results. Use files you upload, supported public music links, or tracks in your Neural Analog library. Requires a Neural Analog account; processing uses its available minutes and plan entitlements. Processing and effects can replace saved mix settings while retaining source audio files.
